youtube.title: ₹5,000 SIP → ₹50 Lakh? Why It Feels Slow #Shorts
youtube.description:
Why does your SIP feel useless in the first 5 years? Compounding explained in 45 seconds. ₹5,000 a month for 5 years: ₹3 lakh in, about ₹4.1 lakh. 10 years: ₹6 lakh in, about ₹11.6 lakh. 20 years: ₹12 lakh in, about ₹50 lakh. The growth shows up late, and most people quit right before the curve bends.

Figures assume a 12% yearly return for illustration. Real returns go up and down, and nothing is guaranteed.

How many years has your SIP been running? Comment below.
